name: DocuMind AI Benchmark Evaluation Dataset
description: 22 challenging multi-type evaluation questions across financial, policy, and technical whitepapers

questions.question: What was Acme Technologies' total revenue in Q3 2024?
questions.expected_answer: $42.5 million

questions.question: When was the CloudScale product line officially launched?
questions.expected_answer: August 15, 2024

questions.question: What was the total R&D expenditure across Q3 and Q4 2024 combined?
questions.expected_answer: $26.4 million ($12.1 million in Q3 plus $14.3 million in Q4)

questions.question: How did Acme's enterprise retention rate change between Q3 2024 and Q4 2024?
questions.expected_answer: The enterprise retention rate decreased from 94.0% in Q3 2024 to 91.5% in Q4 2024 (a decrease of 2.5 percentage points).

questions.question: Compare total headcount at Acme between Q3 2024 and Q4 2024.
questions.expected_answer: Headcount increased from 480 employees at the end of Q3 2024 to 520 employees at the end of Q4 2024, representing a net addition of 40 employees.

questions.question: What were the primary drivers for CloudScale ARR growth and what was the ending ARR in Q4 2024?
questions.expected_answer: CloudScale ending ARR reached $22 million in Q4 2024, driven by accelerated enterprise customer migration, expansion of multi-cloud connectors, and new AI workload optimizations.

questions.question: What is the effective date of Acme's Remote Work Policy v2.0?
questions.expected_answer: January 1, 2024

questions.question: What are the core working hours in the 2023 policy compared to the 2024 policy?
questions.expected_answer: Under the 2023 policy, core working hours were 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST, whereas under the 2024 policy, core working hours are 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM EST.

questions.question: What is the annual home office stipend allowed under the 2024 remote work policy?
questions.expected_answer: $800 per employee per calendar year.

questions.question: How did the maximum allowable days for international remote work change between the 2023 and 2024 policies?
questions.expected_answer: International remote work allowance increased from 30 days per calendar year in 2023 to 45 days per calendar year in 2024.

questions.question: What is the daily travel reimbursement threshold requiring VP approval under the 2024 policy?
questions.expected_answer: Travel expenses exceeding $650 per day require prior written approval from a Vice President.

questions.question: Which dense embedding model and vector dimension are specified in the DocuMind technical whitepaper?
questions.expected_answer: The platform uses the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model producing 384-dimensional dense vector embeddings.

questions.question: What are the default BM25 parameters k1 and b used in DocuMind's keyword retrieval engine?
questions.expected_answer: BM25 uses k1 = 1.5 and b = 0.75.

questions.question: How does DocuMind fuse rankings from BM25 and vector search, and what is the default RRF constant k?
questions.expected_answer: DocuMind uses Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) where score = sum(1 / (k + rank_i)), with a default fusion constant k = 60.

questions.question: Which cross-encoder reranker model is recommended in the technical whitepaper for top-K reranking?
questions.expected_answer: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2

questions.question: What was Acme Technologies' full-year 2024 annual revenue?
questions.expected_answer: $175.2 million

questions.question: What is the annual home office stipend?
questions.expected_answer: The stipend depends on the policy version: under the 2023 policy it was $1,200 per year, but under the updated 2024 policy it was reduced to $800 per year.

questions.question: What was the net income for Acme Technologies in Q3 2024 versus Q4 2024?
questions.expected_answer: Net income was $8.2 million in Q3 2024 and increased to $9.5 million in Q4 2024.

questions.question: What is the projected Q1 2025 revenue guidance for Acme Technologies?
questions.expected_answer: The documents do not provide Q1 2025 revenue guidance. The reports only contain historical data through Q4 2024.

questions.question: What dental insurance benefits does Acme provide to remote employees?
questions.expected_answer: The remote work policy does not mention dental or health insurance benefits.

questions.question: What is the stock ticker symbol for Acme Technologies on NASDAQ?
questions.expected_answer: The ticker symbol is not stated in the provided financial reports.

questions.question: What distance metric is configured for vector similarity in ChromaDB according to the whitepaper?
questions.expected_answer: Cosine distance (or cosine similarity).
